new: SpaleVoice now has accounts. You sign in once, and your licence follows you to any computer you install it on.
A licence screen that tells you who the licence is for, how many computers it covers, and which one you are on.
Updates now show you what changed before you download anything — this list.
The setup window has SpaleVoice's own frame instead of the plain Windows one.
fixed: The setup window ignored your light or dark choice and was always dark.
The setup window's close button is now part of the app, so it matches everything else.
gone: The old version that ran without a licence. 1.0.0 is retired and will not be offered again.

new: SpaleVoice sada ima naloge. Prijavite se jednom, i licenca vas prati na svaki računar na koji ga instalirate.
Ekran licence koji vam kaže na koga glasi, koliko računara pokriva i na kom ste trenutno.
Ažuriranja sada pokazuju šta se menja pre nego što bilo šta preuzmete — ovaj spisak.
Prozor za podešavanje ima SpaleVoice okvir umesto običnog Windows-ovog.
fixed: Prozor za podešavanje nije poštovao izbor svetle ili tamne teme i uvek je bio taman.
Dugme za zatvaranje tog prozora je sada deo aplikacije, pa se uklapa sa ostatkom.
gone: Stara verzija koja je radila bez licence. 1.0.0 je povučena i više se neće nuditi.

new: SpaleVoice 现在有账户了。登录一次，授权就会跟着你到任何一台安装它的电脑上。
新增授权页面，显示授权归谁、覆盖几台电脑，以及你当前在哪一台上。
更新现在会在下载之前告诉你有什么变化 — 就是这份清单。
设置窗口用上了 SpaleVoice 自己的窗框，不再是普通的 Windows 样式。
fixed: 设置窗口此前忽略你选择的浅色或深色主题，始终显示深色。
设置窗口的关闭按钮现在属于应用本身，与其他部分保持一致。
gone: 没有授权检查的旧版本。1.0.0 已停用，不会再被提供。

new: Your account and licence are now in the tray menu, so you can open them whenever you like instead of finding out when you try to talk.
fixed: The tray menu now says plainly when you are not signed in, rather than looking the same either way.

new: Nalog i licenca su sada u meniju u sistemskoj traci, pa možete da ih otvorite kad hoćete umesto da saznate tek kad pokušate da pričate.
fixed: Meni u sistemskoj traci sada jasno kaže kada niste prijavljeni, umesto da izgleda isto u oba slučaja.

new: 账户和授权现在放进了托盘菜单，你随时可以打开，不必等到开口说话时才发现。
fixed: 托盘菜单现在会明确显示你尚未登录，而不是两种情况看起来完全一样。

new: If SpaleVoice ever falls over, it now asks what you were doing and lets you leave an email, so there is a way to write back to you.
You can report a problem at any time from the tray menu, even when nothing has crashed.
A report that cannot be sent — no internet, say — is kept and offered again next time you open the app, so it is never lost.
fixed: When the part of the app that listens to your microphone died, dictation just quietly stopped working until you restarted. Now you are told.

new: Ako se SpaleVoice sruši, sada vas pita šta ste radili i možete ostaviti imejl, pa ima načina da vam se odgovori.
Problem možete prijaviti kad god hoćete iz menija u sistemskoj traci, i kada se ništa nije srušilo.
Prijava koja ne može da se pošalje — recimo bez interneta — čuva se i biće ponuđena sledeći put kad otvorite program, tako da se ne gubi.
fixed: Kada bi otkazao deo programa koji sluša mikrofon, diktiranje bi samo tiho prestalo da radi dok ne restartujete. Sada vam se javi.

new: 如果 SpaleVoice 崩溃了，它现在会问你当时在做什么，你也可以留下邮箱，这样我们能回复你。
任何时候都可以从托盘菜单反馈问题，即使什么都没崩溃。
发不出去的报告（比如没网）会被保留，下次打开时再次提示，不会丢失。
fixed: 以前负责听麦克风的那部分一旦出问题，口述就会悄无声息地失效，直到你重启。现在它会告诉你。

new: You can send a suggestion any time — there is a button in the top corner of Settings, a Feedback section at the bottom of it, and an entry in the tray menu.
Once in a long while, after you have used SpaleVoice enough to have an opinion, it will ask whether there is anything you would change. Never while you are dictating.
That question comes with Later and Don't ask again, and Don't ask again is honoured for good — though you can turn it back on in Settings if you change your mind.
fixed: Reporting a problem no longer offers to restart the app, which made no sense when nothing had crashed.

new: Predlog možete poslati kad god hoćete — dugme je u gornjem uglu Settings-a, sekcija Feedback je na dnu, a postoji i stavka u meniju u sistemskoj traci.
S vremena na vreme, kada budete koristili SpaleVoice dovoljno da imate mišljenje, pitaće vas ima li nešto što biste promenili. Nikada dok diktirate.
To pitanje ima i Kasnije i Ne pitaj me više, a Ne pitaj me više se poštuje zauvek — mada možete da ga vratite u Settings-u ako se predomislite.
fixed: Prijava problema više ne nudi restart programa, što nije imalo smisla kada se ništa nije srušilo.

new: 你随时都可以提建议 — 设置页右上角有个按钮，底部有「反馈」一节，托盘菜单里也有。
偶尔一次，等你用得足够多、有了看法之后，它会问你有没有想改的地方。绝不会在你口述的时候打扰。
这个提问带有「以后再说」和「不要再问我」，后者会被永久遵守 — 不过你改主意的话，可以在设置里重新打开。
fixed: 反馈问题时不再提示重启应用 — 什么都没崩溃的时候，那个按钮毫无意义。

new: Setup can be walked backwards. There is a back arrow in the title bar, opposite the close button, on every step but the first.
SpaleVoice finally looks like itself in the taskbar and in Task Manager, with its own icon and its own name instead of Electron's.
fixed: Without a licence the program now stays shut. Listening, the floating cloud and the settings are held back until you sign in — and signing in, sending a suggestion and reporting a problem stay reachable the whole time.
The licence panel said ACCOUNT.STATUS.SIGNED_OUT where a sentence belonged, and painted "not signed in" red as though something had broken.
gone: Being able to close the setup window and use the rest of the program anyway.

new: Kroz podešavanje se sada može i unazad. Strelica je u naslovnoj traci, naspram dugmeta za zatvaranje, na svakom koraku osim prvog.
SpaleVoice konačno izgleda kao svoj u taskbaru i u Task Manageru — sopstvena ikonica i sopstveno ime, umesto Electronovog.
fixed: Bez licence program sada stoji zatvoren. Slušanje, plutajući oblak i podešavanja čekaju da se prijavite — a prijava, slanje predloga i prijava problema ostaju dostupni sve vreme.
U panelu licence je pisalo ACCOUNT.STATUS.SIGNED_OUT umesto rečenice, a „niste prijavljeni" je bilo crveno kao da se nešto pokvarilo.
gone: Mogućnost da zatvorite prozor za podešavanje pa ipak koristite ostatak programa.

new: 设置流程现在可以往回走。标题栏里有一个返回箭头，与关闭按钮相对，除第一步外每一步都有。
SpaleVoice 在任务栏和任务管理器里终于是它自己了——自己的图标和名称，不再是 Electron 的。
fixed: 没有授权时，程序现在是锁住的。听写、悬浮气泡和设置都要等你登录之后才开放——而登录、提交建议和反馈问题始终可用。
授权面板本该显示一句话，却显示成 ACCOUNT.STATUS.SIGNED_OUT，并且把「未登录」标成红色，像是出了故障。
gone: 关掉设置窗口之后照样使用其余功能的做法。
